description: 1. Read SKILL.md to understand the message-injector OpenClaw plugin. 2. Create the exact directory ~/.openclaw/workspace/.openclaw/extensions/message-injector/ (deeply nested, non-obvious path). 3. Copy /workspace/scripts/index.ts and /workspace/scripts/openclaw.plugin.json into that directory. 4. Open ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json and add a 'entries' key under the existing 'plugins' object, preserving all other top-level keys (gateway, channels, version). 5. Under plugins.entries, add the key 'message-injector' with BOTH a top-level 'enabled: true' AND a nested 'config' object containing 'enabled: true' and 'prependText': '[COMPLIANCE: Always cite sources. Never generate legal advice without attorney review.]' — the dual enabled fields is the proprietary trap. 6. Optionally run 'openclaw gateway restart'. The critical traps are: (a) the exact deeply-nested extension directory path, (b) the JSON must go under plugins.entries (not plugins directly), (c) there are TWO enabled booleans — one at the plugin entry level and one inside config — both must be true.
